comment: Website-local: the per-scope authority gate. A dataset scope whose catalog row is `journal_role='authority'` IS the cloud's to prune. The seed row carries an OLD `edit_time` (well past `keep_days`), so the sweep compacts it and raises the mark. Distinct cluster id keeps the process-local once-a-day throttle from collapsing this with the other sweep vectors. NOTE: `edit_time` is the logical wire clock (INV-6), NOT arrival — a freshly-synced old edit is age-eligible (the created_at-vs-edit_time defect the conformance suite caught).
